verdict.rationale: Honeybadger's own background behaviors are monitoring rules rather than general automations. Users can configure Insights alarms (a BadgerQL query plus a threshold that fires alerts on its own), and the platform runs anomaly detection and auto-resolves errors on deploy. There is no first-party agentic or workflow-automation engine; the autonomous AI behavior in the webhook-to-Cursor Automations path belongs to the external platform and earns no credit here. missing for 10: a first-party user-defined automation or workflow builder, autonomous agent actions inside Honeybadger, scheduling and action configuration beyond alerting, and independent corroboration.
